contact_sheet_review.method: Viewed all fifteen contact sheets. Inspected all eight title2 pages, cmntex member 0, title members 0 and 3, and ending member 0 at full resolution. Also viewed town01 member 7 at full resolution to assess decorative writing.
findings: All readily legible Japanese interface text in these sheets is concentrated in title2 help/warning pages plus the title, ending and small company-name graphics listed here.
The cmntex member 0 atlas contains a tiny text-like strip that remains unreadable and unconfirmed as Japanese.

Town tavern backgrounds contain tiny decorative notices and bottles with indistinct, stylized writing. The full-resolution town01 member 7 artwork does not yield reliable natural-language transcription. Do not invent readable poster text.

Enemy portraits, character portraits, dungeon material textures and chest/map artwork showed no additional legible Japanese prose in the contact-sheet review. This is visual triage, not OCR or an exhaustive claim about every pixel in every source asset.

verification_required: Compare every replacement at native resolution and in the actual game.
Preserve source image dimensions, channels, alpha behavior, texture format and archive member identity.
Verify texture atlas UV rectangles before changing cmntex; no translation is authorized for the unreadable strip without further evidence.
Inspect independent package graphics and movie frames separately; they are outside this contact-sheet review.
